name: Majiyome
source:
Rukuto lives in an ordinary town. His school is ordinary. His house is ordinary as well. Rukuto's father, Jitarou, is an ordinary white-collar worker. Everything around Rukuto seems ordinary. But, there is one thing extraordinary about him. He is actually a son of the devil! Jitarou is the boss of the devil world! But one day, Jitarou gets injured seriously, and appoints Rukuto as his successor. But, there is another problem that Rukuto must get married to be the boss of the devil world.... And he starts looking for his wife....

[From Himeya Shop]
translation:
Rukuto住在一个平凡的小镇上。他的学校很普通，他的家也很普通。Rukuto的父亲逢魔滋多吕宇是一名普通的上班族。Rukuto身边的一切看似平淡无奇，但他有一个不为人知的秘密——他其实是魔王之子！逢魔滋多吕宇正是魔界的统治者！然而有一天，逢魔滋多吕宇身受重伤，指定Rukuto为继承人。但还有一个问题：要想成为魔界之王，Rukuto必须先结婚……于是他开始寻找自己的新娘……

[改编自Himeya Shop]
